standout_why: Compared against four pages I opened today; deskfinds.com returned HTTP 403 and was not read. The Office Journal under-$150 page (updated 2026-09-11) names four single-screen picks (Cevaton 15.6, KEFEYA 14 Premium, ROYY 14, Miesebe 14) with no dollar price except a $89.99 KEFEYA base model, no per-product video path and no fit range. Dejaflow prices ten models as of 2026-02-16, and is the only one with a two-added-screen pick under $150 (AOKER dual 15.6 at $139.00) and a driver note (SideTrak Slide 12.5, DisplayLink). Twelve Tabs prices four Amazon listings as of 2026-10-02; only two are under $150 (KYY 15.6 at $59.49, Arzopa Z1FC at $109.99). Deal.ai has dated November prices for 12 picks from Walmart, Newegg, eBay and Amazon, but states no video path per model. So rivals already have dated prices for other models (why this is 2, not 3). None lists FOPO S1, Mobile Pixels Fold or Glance, none says what sits just over $150, and none mentions that base M1/M2/M3 MacBooks drive one external display.
decides: It confirms the page can keep to $150 with two rows we link, and it splits the pick by screen count. For two added screens (a three-screen desk), FOPO S1 at {after:fopo-s1-dual-14-inch-laptop-screen-extender} is the one maker-store dual I could price under $150 today; it clears the line only with code FOPO (store price $159.99). For one added screen, Mobile Pixels Fold 15.6-inch at $143.99 is the linkable row (needs a product record), but it is freestanding, not attached, and it is not the price winner: Arzopa Z1FC 16.1-inch 144 Hz is $92.13 at arzopa.com today, also freestanding, so Fold wins only as the linkable row. I could not open Walmart, Best Buy or Micro Center, so ChatGPT's own picks (SIAVIALA $94.89–$109.89, UPERFECT 14-inch $135.99, ASUS MB169CK $89.99) are not re-priced, and the attachable single-screen winner is not settled by this angle. Left out for being over: Glance 16-inch $151.99, Fold 16-inch QHD $167.99, Duex DS series from $183.99, FOPO S7 $180.00 through our link.
